name: Pendarr III
description: Pendarr III was a planet located in the Pendarr system within the Alchenaut sector of the Expansion Region and Trailing Sectors. It was situated in grid square L-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Pendarr III was the homeworld of Davits Draven, a human general in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Intelligence Service.
